description: Conformance vectors for policy approval of matching OAuth self-registrations (OAUTH_DCR_AUTO_APPROVE_POLICY). Neutral placeholder names and documentation addresses only. Consumed by dcr-auto-approval.test.ts; a second implementation (for example a deploy-side validator) can replay them.

rules.documents: Each item gives the raw policy text in 'document', or 'document_padded': the 'base' text followed by ASCII spaces up to exactly 'pad_to_bytes' UTF-8 bytes. 'expect' is accept or reject. For accept, 'entries' is the effective policy (client_name NFC, allowed_cidrs canonical and sorted) and 'policy_version' is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the compact JSON of {version:1, entries:[{id, client_name, redirect:{host, path, port_min, port_max}, allowed_cidrs, max_per_hour}]} with keys in exactly that order, no whitespace, non-ASCII characters unescaped. For reject, 'reason' (and 'at', where present) is what the fork reports; a second implementation must reject but need not use the same reason.
rules.numbers: Every number must be written as a plain integer literal: a fraction or exponent ('1.0', '2e1') refuses the document, as does NaN or Infinity. A key repeated within one object (compared after unescaping) refuses the document.
rules.lengths: client_name length is counted in UTF-16 code units after NFC normalisation (1 to 255). Whitespace-only means made only of U+0009-U+000D, U+0020, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000-U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000 and U+FEFF. A name containing a lone surrogate is refused.
rules.cidrs: Canonical spelling is lowercase RFC 5952 compression with IPv4-mapped addresses written dotted (::ffff:198.51.100.0), an explicit prefix, and a bare address read as /32 or /128. Surrounding whitespace, a zone id or host bits refuse the entry.
rules.matches: 'registration' is the effective client after the fork's shared registration core has applied its defaults and its own checks (the core separately refuses the gateway's internal port and non-loopback callbacks before matching). 'policy' names an entry in 'policies'. 'expect' is the matched entry id or null. The hourly budget is not part of these stateless cases.
